basic_details.job_title: CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has officially announced the Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. Candidates holding an LLB degree, a valid Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council, and at least 10 years of experience in handling criminal matters are eligible to apply online on or before 27 July 2026. Direct links to download the official notification PDF and submit the online application are shared below.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CBI to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CBI Special Public Prosecutor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CBI Special Public Prosecutor recruitment is 27 July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Special Public Prosecutor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Special Public Prosecutor post in the Central Bureau of Investigation.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an LLB degree, an Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council, and a minimum of 10 years of standing as an Advocate with experience in handling criminal matters.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Special Public Prosecutor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interaction with the candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Special Public Prosecutor position is contractual.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the recruitment taking place?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a position in Ranchi, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Ranchi, Jharkhand. Interested candidates from other states should verify eligibility and relocation possibilities.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 2351/.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
